name: Toolchain Probe
description: Reports the local toolchain the Agent will actually get — git and python3 versions, plus the worker's own Node runtime — by running allowlisted commands in a bundled Node worker.
whenToUse: Use before a task depends on a local CLI: cloning or committing (git), running a script or a build (python3), or checking which runtime is available. Answers "is it installed, and which version" instead of assuming.
author: chanolan20

tools.name: check_toolchain
tools.description: Report whether git and python3 are installed locally and which version each one is, by running them with fixed arguments inside this plugin's bundled Node worker. Parameters: `tools` (array, optional — any of "git", "python3"; default both). Returns JSON { runtime: { node, platform, arch }, tools: [{ name, found, version, hint }], missing: [name], note }. A tool that is absent is a successful result with `found: false` and an actionable `hint`, not an error — relay the hint to the user. This tool only reads: it runs `<tool> --version` with no shell and writes nothing. If the worker itself cannot answer, the result is `ok: false` with NODE_REQUEST_FAILED.
Optional subset to probe. Omit it to check both git and python3.
